title: How often do you dream of malls? Do friendly people lead you to the exit?
content: The malls are always the same, but different, as in the more I walk through the more it shifts. I feel like I have a couple a month. They started at about 28 or so and I'm about to turn 31. It flows from and indoor to outdoor setting all in one. There's a jewelry store I always go into. An arcade and movie theater. This clothing store always wants to hire me. It has a hot topic mixed with Hollister vibe. The food court always tempts me too. Theres also a bar/restaurant i visit with a wooden ramp leading to it and seems like a steakhouse/seafood. It's always full of life, people every where and I generally feel a good energy being there. Almost like excitement. Then sometimes it shifts to anxiety because I just want to leave, or find someone that's waiting for me outside the mall and no matter what I can't get to an exit. I've even ended up in back parts of the mall that turn into an outdoor setting like a beach city with more people and my mind gets fucked. When my tension starts getting really bad of wanting to leave someone always runs into me that's familiar! (Not in real life but their energy feels like they are my friends and ive met them before) like a group of skateboarding guys or these girls that ride their bikes around. They see I'm lost and say "cmon I know where the exit is, follow me!" And they lead me to the entrance of the mall and when I thank them they smile, and thats where I always wake right up when I get there so I can never recall what the entrance looks like. This shit is crazy. I'm happy I found this sub. I feel seen.
